notes: test_rmw_implementation is a gtest suite for the rmw API; the snapshot also contains the sibling package rmw_implementation, which was not treated as this package. All nine api:* packet elements are C functions of the rmw API that this package only calls (side consumes); they are listed in references with one representative call site each in test_subscription.cpp (they are also called in the other test files); frame, units, QoS and definition_id are null for them because they are function symbols, not topic endpoints, and their header declarations (rmw package) are not an allowed source. The packet marks msg:test_msgs/BasicTypes as provides, but this package defines no interfaces (no msg/srv/idl files, no rosidl_generate_interfaces); it consumes the type from test_msgs, so it is recorded in not_declared and also in references. The definition is not in ros2/rcl_interfaces test_msgs/msg on rolling; test_msgs builds it from ros2/test_interface_files, fetched at the rolling branch tip (not pinned to the snapshot's date); its 13 fields match the fields compared in test_subscription.cpp:830-845. QoS for the BasicTypes port is left null because the code creates BasicTypes subscriptions on topic /test with several different fixed profiles (rmw_qos_profile_default at :82, a native variant at :93-96, rmw_qos_profile_system_default at :251, and in the TestSubscriptionUse fixture rmw_qos_profile_default with reliability explicitly set to RMW_QOS_POLICY_RELIABILITY_RELIABLE at :281/:298, which is the subscription rmw_take_sequence is called on); the numeric contents of rmw_qos_profile_default live in the rmw headers, which are not an allowed source. rmw_take_sequence is only called in test_subscription.cpp (lines 545-647); the take_sequence test fills the sequence with test_msgs/Strings messages (:27 include, :535, :555) while the subscription type is test_msgs/BasicTypes.
